metadata.name: Webhook Trigger
metadata.summary: Generic inbound HTTP webhook trigger for Greentic flows
metadata.description: Ships the canonical webhook trigger nodeType plus three design-time tools (validate_webhook_config, suggest_path, infer_auth_from_curl). Webhook is operator-side ingress — the runtime exposes an HTTP listener, validates auth, and kicks off flow execution when a request matches the configured path. The tools help the designer LLM produce a valid trigger config from natural-language intent or a sample curl an upstream system would send.

nodeTypes.label: Webhook Trigger
nodeTypes.config_schema: {"type":"object","required":["method","path"],"properties":{"method":{"type":"string","enum":["GET","POST","PUT","PATCH"],"default":"POST","description":"HTTP method the webhook accepts"},"path":{"type":"string","description":"URL path the runtime listens on (e.g. /webhook/orders)","examples":["/webhook/orders","/hooks/slack-event","/api/intake"]},"auth":{"type":"object","description":"Authentication policy applied to incoming requests","properties":{"type":{"type":"string","enum":["none","bearer","hmac","basic"],"default":"none"},"secret_ref":{"type":"string","description":"Secret name holding the auth credential (for bearer / hmac / basic)"}}},"signature_validation":{"type":"object","description":"Optional HMAC signature check applied to the request body","properties":{"header":{"type":"string","examples":["X-Hub-Signature-256","X-Slack-Signature"]},"algorithm":{"type":"string","enum":["hmac-sha256","hmac-sha1"],"default":"hmac-sha256"},"secret_ref":{"type":"string","description":"Secret name holding the signing key"}}},"allowed_sources":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Optional CIDR allowlist for the request's source IP (e.g. \"203.0.113.0/24\")"}}}
